# Avalo Therapeutics to Participate in Upcoming Investor Conferences


November 24, 2026 7:00am EST


WAYNE, Pa., Nov. 24, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Avalo Therapeutics, Inc. (Nasdaq: AVTX), a clinical stage biotechnology company dedicated to developing therapeutics targeting the IL-1β pathway for immune-mediated inflammatory diseases, today announced that management will participate in the following investor conferences:


**Evercore ISI 9** **th** **Annual Healthcare Conference**
1x1 meetings only
December 1, 2026


**Piper Sandler & Co Annual Healthcare Conference**
Fireside Chat
December 2, 2026, at 9:00 A.M. ET


Live webcasts and replays, when available, can be found under "News / Events" in the Investors section of the Avalo Therapeutics website at https://ir.avalotx.com. The archived webcast will be available for replay for at least 30 days.


**About Avalo Therapeutics**


Avalo Therapeutics is a clinical stage biotechnology company dedicated to developing therapeutics targeting the IL-1β pathway for immune-mediated inflammatory diseases. Avalo is advancing its lead anti-IL-1β monoclonal antibody (mAb) drug candidate, abdakibart, into a phase 3 registrational program in hidradenitis suppurativa (HS), a chronic inflammatory skin condition that affects an estimated 1-4% of the population globally. Avalo is pursuing additional development opportunities in IL-1β driven indications. Avalo is also developing AVTX-010, a long-acting next-generation anti-IL-1β mAb. For more information about Avalo, please visit[www.avalotx.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=dP5XFgY4GHzheDFjBlTN8fQXCx-nPahN_OZNzl6zRAMiYKPBUp03JydBMwWD3XFv9iaqmXAKvppaqoYovieVCA==) .
